안녕하세요.x: Hello, teacher! The weather is nice today.
안녕하세요.e: Literally 'Are you at peace?' — the everyday polite hello.
안녕하세요.t: Works any time of day — morning, afternoon or evening. A slight bow while saying it is polite.

넷.forms: native · counting things, hours, age · before a counter: 네 (네 개, 네 시)
넷.x: There are four people in the room.
넷.t: Before a counter 넷 becomes 네: 네 명, 네 시.

옷.x: I bought new clothes at the department store on the weekend.
옷.e: 옷장 = wardrobe; 옷 가게 = clothing store. 옷을 입다 = put on clothes.
옷.t: Pronounced [옫]; with a vowel after it the ㅅ comes back: 옷이 [오시], 옷을 [오슬].

벗다.x: Please take off your shoes here.
벗다.e: 신발 벗으세요 = take off your shoes (at Korean homes).
벗다.t: One verb for taking off everything — clothes, shoes, hats, glasses.

고장 나다.forms: 고장 나요 · 고장 났어요 · 고장 날 거예요 · 고장 난 (+noun)
고장 나다.m: to break down, to be out of order
고장 나다.ex: 세탁기가 고장 나서 빨래를 못 해요.
고장 나다.x: The washing machine broke, so I can't do the laundry.
고장 나다.t: Used for machines; for snapped or shattered things, use 부러지다 or 깨지다 instead.

더욱.forms: 더욱 + adjective/verb; 더욱더 = even more and more
더욱.x: After I started exercising, I got even healthier.
더욱.e: A stronger, more written-sounding cousin of 더 'more'.

원숭이.x: The monkey climbs the tree and eats a banana.

기록.ex: 그 선수가 마라톤에서 새로운 기록을 세웠어요.
기록.x: That athlete set a new record in the marathon.

실적.ex: 이번 달 영업 실적이 아주 좋아요.
실적.x: Our sales results this month are very good.

체중.x: After I started exercising, I lost five kilograms.
체중.t: 체중 is formal or medical; in everyday talk people say 몸무게.

고백하다.m: to confess (one's feelings), to tell someone you like them; to confess (a secret or wrongdoing)
고백하다.x: Yesterday I told the person I like how I feel.
고백하다.t: In Korean dating, 고백 is the moment you ask someone to be your partner, which usually starts the relationship.

촛불.x: I made a wish and blew out the candles on the cake.
촛불.t: Pronounced [초뿔]: the ㅅ added between the two parts makes the ㅂ tense. Blowing out candles is 촛불을 끄다, literally 'turn off the candles'.

논평.ex: 정당은 그 사건에 대해 공식 논평을 냈어요.
논평.x: The party issued an official comment on the incident.

한방.ex: 요즘 한방 치료를 받는 외국인도 많아요.
한방.x: These days many foreigners also get traditional Korean medical treatment.
한방.e: Literally 'Korean methods/prescriptions'; don't confuse with native 한 방 'one hit, one shot.'

수강.ex: 이번 학기에 다섯 과목을 수강하고 있어요.
수강.x: I'm taking five classes this semester.

출석부.x: The teacher called our names while looking at the roll.

멸종 위기.ex: 이 새는 멸종 위기 동물이라서 보호를 받아요.
멸종 위기.x: This bird is an endangered animal, so it is protected.
멸종 위기.e: Literally 'the crisis of a species being wiped out'.
멸종 위기.t: Common patterns: 멸종 위기 동물 = endangered animal; 멸종 위기에 처하다 = to face extinction.

서식지.ex: 개발 때문에 동물들의 서식지가 줄어들고 있어요.
서식지.x: Animal habitats are shrinking because of development.
서식지.t: Pronounced [서식찌]: ㅈ becomes tense after the ㄱ batchim.

사막화.ex: 숲이 사라지면서 사막화가 빠르게 진행되고 있어요.
사막화.x: As forests disappear, desertification is progressing quickly.

죄책감.ex: 거짓말을 한 후에 계속 죄책감이 들었어요.
죄책감.x: After I lied, I kept feeling guilty.
죄책감.e: Literally 'feeling of blame for wrongdoing'. -감 = a feeling: 죄책감, 기대감, 호감.
죄책감.t: Use 죄책감이 들다 or 죄책감을 느끼다 'to feel guilty'.

자상하다.ex: 우리 아빠는 정말 자상하고 따뜻한 분이세요.
자상하다.x: My dad is a really caring and warm person.
자상하다.e: Literally 'careful and detailed' — attentive to every little need.

대폭.forms: 대폭 + change verb (대폭 늘리다/줄이다); noun: 대폭 할인
대폭.m: drastically, sharply, by a large margin
대폭.ex: 정부는 내년 예산을 대폭 늘리기로 했습니다.
대폭.x: The government decided to sharply increase next year's budget.
대폭.e: Literally 'big width': a change of large scale.
대폭.t: A news favorite with 인상, 인하, 증가, 감소; the opposite is 소폭 'slightly'.

오직.x: You're the only person I can trust.

밀접하다.x: Health is closely related to eating habits.
밀접하다.t: Pronounced [밀쩌파다]; almost always 밀접한 관계 or 밀접하게 연결되다.

한정되다.m: to be limited, to be restricted
한정되다.ex: 이 행사는 참가 인원이 백 명으로 한정돼요.
한정되다.x: This event is limited to one hundred participants.
한정되다.t: Pattern: N(으)로 한정되다 'to be limited to N'; 한정된 시간 'limited time'.

낯을 가리다.forms: 낯을 가려요 · 낯을 가렸어요 · 낯을 많이 가리다
낯을 가리다.m: to be shy with strangers, to be wary of new people
낯을 가리다.ex: 우리 아이는 낯을 많이 가려서 처음에는 말을 안 해요.
낯을 가리다.x: My kid is really shy around strangers, so he doesn't talk at first.
낯을 가리다.e: 낯 = face; 가리다 here means 'to tell apart,' sorting familiar faces from unfamiliar ones.
낯을 가리다.t: A very common self-description: 저는 낯을 좀 가려요 means 'I'm a bit shy at first.'

난방비.x: Our heating bill was high this winter.
난방비.e: Literally 'warm-room cost'. -비 = cost: 난방비, 교통비, 관리비.
난방비.t: Bills 'come out' in Korean: 난방비가 많이 나왔어요 'the heating bill came out high'.

부양하다.m: to support, to provide for (a family)
부양하다.ex: 그는 혼자서 가족 다섯 명을 부양해요.
부양하다.x: He supports a family of five on his own.
부양하다.t: Usually appears as 가족을 부양하다; 부양가족 (dependents) shows up on tax and job forms.

인증서.m: (digital) certificate, e-certificate (for online banking and government sites)
인증서.x: I forgot my certificate password, so I had it reissued.
인증서.t: Korean banking and government websites use a digital certificate to confirm who you are. The old 공인 인증서 was renamed 공동 인증서 in 2020, and certificates issued inside apps are now common too. Get one issued: 인증서를 발급받다.

매각.ex: 그 기업은 빚을 갚기 위해 자회사를 매각했어요.
매각.x: The company sold off a subsidiary to pay its debts.

신성하다.m: to be sacred, to be holy
신성하다.x: This is a sacred place to the villagers.

규격.ex: 이 제품은 국제 규격에 맞게 만들어졌습니다.
규격.x: This product was made to meet international standards.
규격.t: In Korea, 종량제 규격 봉투 are the official trash bags you must buy.

희로애락.m: the joys and sorrows of life; all human emotions
희로애락.ex: 이 영화에는 인생의 희로애락이 담겨 있어요.
희로애락.x: This movie captures all the joys and sorrows of life.
희로애락.t: Spelled 희로, not 희노: 노 'anger' softens to 로 here; pronounced [히로애락].

운명론.ex: 모든 것이 정해져 있다는 운명론에 동의하지 않아요.
운명론.x: I don't agree with the fatalistic view that everything is predetermined.

헌법소원.x: He filed a constitutional complaint, saying his basic rights had been violated.
헌법소원.e: Literally 'constitutional petition' — a citizen asks the court to protect basic rights.

조직검사.ex: 정확한 진단을 위해 조직검사를 해야 합니다.
조직검사.x: A biopsy is needed for an accurate diagnosis.

무작위.x: We split the participants into two groups at random.
무작위.e: Literally 'without deliberate action' — nobody chooses on purpose.
무작위.t: Most often used as 무작위로 (randomly) or before a noun: 무작위 추출 (random sampling).

소립자.ex: 쿼크와 전자는 더 이상 나눌 수 없는 소립자입니다.
소립자.x: Quarks and electrons are elementary particles that cannot be divided further.
소립자.t: Pronounced [소립짜]; in everyday science writing 기본 입자 is also common.

분청사기.m: buncheong ware, gray stoneware coated with white slip
분청사기.x: Buncheong ware is known for its free, unpretentious patterns.
분청사기.e: Literally 'powdered blue-green sand vessel': gray clay brushed with white slip.

천양지차.m: a world of difference, night and day
천양지차.ex: 같은 가격인데도 두 제품의 품질은 천양지차예요.
천양지차.x: Even at the same price, the quality of the two products is night and day.
천양지차.e: Literally 'the gap between heaven and earth'.
천양지차.t: The everyday version is 하늘과 땅 차이.

세습.m: hereditary succession, passing down (wealth, power, status)
세습.ex: 부의 세습이 사회 불평등을 키운다는 지적이 많습니다.
세습.x: Many point out that inherited wealth deepens social inequality.
세습.t: Used for power, wealth or poverty passed down; 상속 is the legal word for inheriting property.

산업폐기물.x: A company that illegally dumped industrial waste was caught.

오래도록.m: for a long time, for long
오래도록.ex: 그 영화는 오래도록 기억에 남을 거예요.
오래도록.x: That movie will stay in my memory for a long time.

엄동설한.m: the dead of winter, bitter winter cold
엄동설한.ex: 엄동설한에 난방도 없이 지내는 이웃들이 있습니다.
엄동설한.x: Some of our neighbors live through the dead of winter without heating.
